title: Scalar compatibility of the local ordered open projection
statement: Let A and B be commutative rings, φ:A→B a unital ring map, j:X→Z an arbitrary open immersion of schemes, T∈D_A(Z), and M∈D_A(X). Write Q for ordinary unbounded derived scalar extension, L_R(j) for left-derived geometric pullback, J_R for exact derived extension by zero, δ for ExceptionalCoefficients.tensorIso, β for ExceptionalCoefficients.openIso and a_j for scalarPullbackIso. Define o_R(j;T,M):T⊗J_R M→J_R(L_R(j)T⊗M) as the inverse signed symmetry, inverse canonical open projection formula, and J_R of the final signed symmetry. Then Q_Z(o_A);β(L_A(j)T⊗M);J_B(δ_X(L_A(j)T,M);(a_j(T)⁻¹⊗id)) = δ_Z(T,J_A M);(id⊗β(M));o_B(j;Q_Z T,Q_X M). This is a local open-immersion square: it has no compactification, proper morphism, or composite-pullback identification. No flatness, boundedness, coefficient finiteness, or quasi-compactness is assumed.

proof.text: Apply the mixed_tensor_scalar field of etaleOpenScalarComparisons at M,T. Its q is the canonical open scalar comparison: uniqueness of the open-adjunction unit transpose identifies it with ExceptionalCoefficients.openIso. Its r is the inverse scalarPullbackIso transported through the exact/left-derived pullback comparisons. The tensor normalization uniqueness theorem identifies the inverse etaleHomTensorComparison with ExceptionalCoefficients.tensorIso. Cancel the invertible comparison and open-projection factors to obtain the forward unordered projection square.

Conjugate the unordered square by the signed tensor symmetries on X and Z. On flat-term K-flat models the normalized scalar tensor comparison is ordinary balancing and the symmetry is the signed swap. In bidegree (p,q) both composites have the sign (-1)^(p*q); scalar coefficients have degree zero. Equality on tensor generators gives equality of chain maps. Localization and naturality extend it to all derived inputs. This also covers zero inputs, the empty open, and zero rings.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleOrderedOpenProjectionScalar
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (φ : A →+* B)
    {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (T : DerivedCategoryModule A Z) (M : DerivedCategoryModule A X) :
    (scalarExtension φ Z).map (orderedOpenProjection A j T M) ≫
      (ExceptionalCoefficients.openIso φ j).hom.app
        (((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).obj
          ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j).leftDerivedFunctor.obj T)).obj M) ≫
      (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) j).mapDerivedCategory.map
        ((ExceptionalCoefficients.tensorIso φ X).hom.app
            ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j).leftDerivedFunctor.obj T, M) ≫
          ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) X).map
            ((scalarPullbackIso φ j).inv.app T)).app ((scalarExtension φ X).obj M)) =
    (ExceptionalCoefficients.tensorIso φ Z).hom.app
        (T, (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j).mapDerivedCategory.obj M) ≫
      ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) Z).obj
        ((scalarExtension φ Z).obj T)).map
          ((ExceptionalCoefficients.openIso φ j).hom.app M) ≫
      orderedOpenProjection B j ((scalarExtension φ Z).obj T)
        ((scalarExtension φ X).obj M)
